title: Ukraine: Critical health supplies destroyed in ongoing Russian attacks
keyFacts: Ongoing and deadly Russian attacks across Ukraine are causing serious healthcare disruption, with more than $1.5 million-worth of medicines and supplies destroyed in four separate strikes on warehouses used by the UN there since July.

title: WHO urges vigilance after Kenya confirms second Ebola case
keyFacts: The World Health Organization (WHO) continues to support Kenya’s efforts to contain Ebola after a second person tested positive for the Bundibugyo virus, the UN agency’s representative in the country said on Thursday.

title: Security Council LIVE: Deaths, demolitions spike in Gaza, West Bank
keyFacts: Amid a rise in lethal Israeli strikes, demolitions and violence in Gaza and the West Bank, the Security Council held an open debate on Thursday focusing on the current situation in the Occupied Palestinian Territory.

title: WHO urges faster action to end lead exposure which kills 3.5 million annually
keyFacts: Countries must accelerate efforts to prevent lead exposure, which is estimated to cause more than 3.5 million deaths globally each year and affects hundreds of millions of children, the World Health Organization (WHO) said on Thursday.

title: Colombia: UN independent experts call for Ecopetrol to provide reparations to victims of armed conflict
keyFacts: UN independent experts welcomed on Wednesday a recent landmark corporate accountability ruling involving the Ecopetrol oil company by Colombia’s Special Jurisdiction for Peace, calling for reparations for victims.
